feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 October 2026 7:36am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 08 October 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing later.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure will decline as Atlantic frontal systems affect the area today.


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 this morning, backing south or southwest 4 or 5 this afternoon, increasing 5 to 7 this evening, veering west or southwest overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later this morning, building mainly moderate in the evening.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain arriving from the west this afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 to 7, veering west tomorrow morning, decreasing west or northwest 5 or 6 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Rain, quickly clearing to showers tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.
